pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the mass Westall school sighting, but when investigators dug into the declassified files, the cover-up went infinitely deeper. Decades later, principal testimonies and radar operator logs confirmed that an unidentified object had indeed breached restricted airspace before landing. Astoundingly, ground soil samples taken right after the event revealed extreme radiation and ring-shaped indentations where the grass was completely vaporized, not burned. Even stranger, local weather bureau records for that exact minute were inexplicably wiped clean from national archives. Witnesses who spoke out decades later faced ongoing intimidation, proving the state was desperate to bury the truth. Was this top-secret experimental aircraft, or did something entirely non-human touch down in an Australian schoolyard?
